title: SpaceX Has Officially Acquired AI Coding Startup Cursor
excerpt: The $60 billion acquisition has been finalized.
content_html:
Cursor says it now has the computing power to develop low-cost AI models.

SpaceX

Cursor, the startup that became famous for its AI coding tool, is now officially owned by SpaceX. The companies announced the acquisition in June, but the process apparently started in April, when they teamed up for Cursor's model training efforts. In its announcement, Cursor said that it will now have access to "the largest fleet of GPUs in the world," which will give it the computing capacity to build and train better models that it can offer its customers at a lower cost.

SpaceX, which merged with Elon Musk's AI company xAI earlier this year, paid $60 billion for the purchase. In July, xAI officially became SpaceXAI. Shortly after the new name was announced, the companies released Grok 4.5, the first model SpaceXAI and Cursor built together. It was designed to "excel at coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work" and to deliver results "at far lower costs." Since then, they have released Grok 4.6, which builds on 4.5. The newer model was trained to do real life tasks like general coding, web development and computer-aided design, among others. Cursor said Grok 4.6 provides an early look at what it can build together with SpaceXAI.

content_html_zh:
Cursor 表示，它现在拥有开发低成本人工智能模型的计算能力。

太空探索技术公司

Cursor 是一家因人工智能编码工具而闻名的初创公司，现已正式归 SpaceX 所有。 两家公司于 6 月份宣布了此次收购，但这一过程显然是在 4 月份开始的，当时他们联手进行 Cursor 的模型训练工作。 Cursor 在声明中表示，它现在将能够使用“世界上最大的 GPU 群”，这将赋予它计算能力来构建和训练更好的模型，从而以更低的成本为客户提供服务。

今年早些时候，SpaceX 与埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的人工智能公司 xAI 合并，此次收购花费了 600 亿美元。 7月，xAI正式更名为SpaceXAI。 新名称宣布后不久，两家公司发布了 Grok 4.5，这是 SpaceXAI 和 Cursor 共同构建的第一个模型。 它的设计目的是“擅长编码、代理任务和知识工作”，并“以低得多的成本”提供结果。 从那时起，他们发布了基于 4.5 构建的 Grok 4.6。 新模型经过训练可以执行现实生活中的任务，例如一般编码、网络开发和计算机辅助设计等。 Cursor 表示，Grok 4.6 可以让我们初步了解它可以与 SpaceXAI 一起构建什么。
